shadows.name: map-control

shadows.name: floating-banner

components.name: Primary Cinnabar Action Button
components.description: Primary court phase and submission CTA (截止征询, 批复结算, 发旨) with solid cinnabar fill and high-contrast muted stone disabled state.
components.css: .ds-btn-row { display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; } .ds-btn-primary { padding: 8px 14px; background: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); border: 1px solid var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); border-radius: 6px; color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-sans-cn, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #8b3126; border-color: #8b3126; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: #7a2920; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--surface-disabled, #e2dcd0); border-color: var(--border-disabled, #d2cabd); color: var(--ink-disabled, #766d61); opacity: 1; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary & Cinnabar Outline Footer Buttons
components.description: Side-by-side 2-column footer actions at the bottom of the state report tab (传讯X州官员 and 审阅X州提案).
components.css: .ds-report-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; width: 364px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-row-divider, #eae3d5); } .ds-btn-secondary, .ds-btn-outline-cinnabar { padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--surface-panel-solid, #faf7f2); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #c2b8a6); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1c18); font-family: var(--font-sans-cn, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline-cinnabar { border-color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-subtle, #f2ece1); } .ds-btn-outline-cinnabar:hover { background: var(--accent-cinnabar-bg, rgba(158, 58, 46, 0.08)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible, .ds-btn-outline-cinnabar:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Four-Week Timeline Step Pills

components.css: .ds-timeline-bar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; background: var(--surface-panel, rgba(250, 247, 242, 0.96)); border-left: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #c2b8a6); border-right: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #c2b8a6); } .ds-timeline-chevron { color: var(--ink-muted, #8c8275); font-size: 14px; user-select: none; } .ds-timeline-pill { padding: 5px 12px; background: var(--surface-panel-solid, #faf7f2); border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #dcd4c6); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink-secondary, #685f54); font-family: var(--font-sans-cn, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-timeline-pill:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--surface-subtle, #f2ece1); color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1c18); } .ds-timeline-pill.is-viewed { border-color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); font-weight: 700; background: #fdfaf7; } .ds-timeline-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-timeline-pill:disabled { background: #f3eee4; color: var(--ink-muted, #8c8275); opacity: 0.65; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: State Sheet 3-Tab Bar (Songti)

components.css: .ds-tabs-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); width: 364px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--surface-panel-solid, #faf7f2); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #dcd4c6); } .ds-tab-btn { padding: 12px 6px 13px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2.5px solid transparent; color: var(--ink-secondary, #685f54); font-family: var(--font-serif-cn, "Songti SC", "STSong", "Noto Serif SC", serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-tab-btn:hover { color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1c18); } .ds-tab-btn.is-active { color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); border-bottom-color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.css: .ds-outliner-list, .ds-outliner-row { box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-outliner-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 324px; padding: 14px 16px; background: var(--surface-panel, rgba(250, 247, 242, 0.96)); border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #dcd4c6); border-radius: 9px; box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(31, 28, 24, 0.05); } .ds-outliner-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 9px 10px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-bottom-color: var(--border-row-divider, #eae3d5); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1c18); font-family: var(--font-serif-cn, "Songti SC", "STSong", "Noto Serif SC", serif); font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-outliner-row:last-child { border-bottom-color: transparent; } .ds-outliner-row:hover { background: var(--surface-subtle, #f2ece1); } .ds-outliner-row.is-selected { background: #f9f3ee; border-color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); } .ds-outliner-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-outliner-left { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--font-serif-cn, "Songti SC", "STSong", "Noto Serif SC", serif); } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; } .ds-dot-urgent { background: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); } .ds-dot-mild { background: var(--accent-ochre, #b87328); } .ds-outliner-summary { font-family: var(--font-serif-cn, "Songti SC", "STSong", "Noto Serif SC", serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-secondary, #685f54); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; line-height: 1.35; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-outliner-row.is-selected .ds-outliner-summary { color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1c18); font-weight: 700; }

components.css: .ds-kv-list { margin: 0; width: 364px; padding: 4px 16px; background: var(--surface-panel-solid, #faf7f2); border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #dcd4c6); border-radius: 9px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-kv-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-row-divider, #eae3d5); } .ds-kv-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-kv-row dt { color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1c18); font-family: var(--font-serif-cn, "Songti SC", "STSong", "Noto Serif SC", serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-kv-row dd { margin: 0; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kv-val { font-family: var(--font-serif-cn, "Songti SC", "STSong", "Noto Serif SC", serif); font-size: 16.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1c18); } .ds-status-urgent { color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); } .ds-kv-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; } .ds-kv-note { font-family: var(--font-sans-cn, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-secondary, #685f54); }

components.css: .ds-decision-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; width: 320px; } .ds-radio-pill { flex: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 5px 10px; background: var(--surface-subtle, #f2ece1); border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #dcd4c6); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1c18); font-family: var(--font-sans-cn, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-radio-pill:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #eae2d3); } .ds-radio-pill.is-approve { background: var(--accent-sage-bg, rgba(88, 120, 84, 0.10)); border-color: var(--accent-sage, #587854); color: var(--accent-sage, #587854); } .ds-radio-pill.is-reject { background: var(--accent-cinnabar-bg, rgba(158, 58, 46, 0.08)); border-color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); } .ds-radio-pill:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-map-dock { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 9px; font-family: var(--font-sans-cn, "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif); } .ds-layer-group { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px; background: var(--surface-panel, rgba(250, 247, 242, 0.96)); border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #dcd4c6); border-radius: 7px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(31, 28, 24, 0.04); } .ds-layer-pill { padding: 5px 16px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1c18); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-layer-pill:hover { background: var(--surface-subtle, #f2ece1); } .ds-layer-pill.is-active { background: #fdfaf7; border-color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); color: var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); font-weight: 700; } .ds-layer-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-cinnabar, #9e3a2e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-legend-card { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; padding: 7px 14px; background: var(--surface-panel, rgba(250, 247, 242, 0.96)); border: 1px solid var(--border-hairline, #dcd4c6); border-radius: 7px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(31, 28, 24, 0.04); } .ds-legend-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-primary, #1f1c18); } .ds-swatch { width: 14px; height: 11px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid rgba(31, 28, 24, 0.25); display: inline-block; } .ds-sw-urgent { background: rgba(181, 68, 52, 0.72); } .ds-sw-mild { background: rgba(200, 138, 59, 0.72); } .ds-sw-stable { background: rgba(122, 154, 118, 0.72); } .ds-sw-unknown { background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #dbd5c8, #dbd5c8 2px, #8e8579 2px, #8e8579 3.5px); } .ds-sw-bg { background: #e6dfcf; }

narrative.overview:
Simu-Emperor uses a simple light historical-cartographic interface where Paradox EU4 supplies the spatial layout only and the visual language is adapted from DeanChensj/jiangshan-map (commit a9cd67c). A continuous full-viewport (100vw × 100vh) SVG map serves as the primary workspace, layering georeferenced shaded relief (terrain_relief.webp), modern reference provincial and coastline boundaries, ranked blue hydrography, and low-opacity multiply watercolor washes across three fictional playable jurisdictions (甲州, 乙州, 丙州) and surrounding non-playable background geography.

Floating UI chrome is kept light and restrained so geography remains dominant. A single 52px top HUD bar, a closable 404px left state sheet, a concise 324px right state outliner, and a compact lower-right map control dock sit on warm ivory panels (rgba(250, 247, 242, 0.96)) separated by 1px stone hairlines (#dcd4c6) and row dividers (#eae3d5). Classical Chinese Songti (--font-serif-cn) carries state titles, top treasury figures, sheet tabs, report key-value rows, outliner rows, and map annotations, while clean sans-serif (--font-sans-cn) handles operational buttons, timeline pills, chat streams, and form controls. Cinnabar (#9e3a2e) marks active selection and primary actions. The system rejects ornate gilded frames, heraldic crests, fantasy illustrations, and dark slate chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Full-viewport (100vw × 100vh) georeferenced SVG map adapted from DeanChensj/jiangshan-map with Mercator projection, shaded relief (terrain_relief.webp at 0.72 opacity), ranked blue rivers and lakes, and 2D occlusion-aware SVG viewBox camera math.

EU4-inspired four-zone spatial layout (unified top HUD bar, closable left state sheet, concise right state outliner, lower-right map layer and camera controls) rendered in flat warm ivory panels without heavy game chrome.

Strict report-only visual encoding across disaster, grain, and silver layers using multiply watercolor washes (urgent cinnabar #b54434, mild ochre #c88a3b, stable sage #7a9a76) and a 45-degree slate diagonal hatch for unreported (UNKNOWN) states.

Dual-type hierarchy pairing classical Songti serif (--font-serif-cn) for editorial headings, tabs, key-value report rows, outliner summaries, and map labels with neutral sans-serif (--font-sans-cn) for operational controls and chat.

Responsive adaptation across 1586×992, 1440×900 (<=1460px), 1280×800 (<=1320px), and 390×844 mobile (<=960px), where the left sheet becomes an opaque full-width pane that suppresses background map bleed while open.
dos: Do keep the interactive geographic map at 100vw × 100vh with low-opacity multiply washes (fill-opacity: 0.30, 0.36 selected, 0.38 hover) so terrain relief and hydrography remain legible underneath.
Do render unreported states (UNKNOWN) with the diagonal hatch pattern (#unknown-hatch-pattern) and explicit '本周未奏报（未知）' text rather than substituting 0 or background fills.

Do use --font-serif-cn for state titles, top bar treasury metrics, drawer tabs, report key-value rows (.sheet-kv-row), and outliner state rows (.outliner-state-row), paired with tabular-nums on all resource figures.
Do reserve --accent-cinnabar (#9e3a2e) for active phase/Action CTAs (截止征询, 批复结算, 发旨), selected tabs/pills, selected state borders (#8c2d22), and urgent disaster/shortage statuses.
Do use the solid muted disabled tokens (background #e2dcd0, border #d2cabd, text #766d61, opacity: 1) on disabled action and primary buttons instead of translucent washed-out fills.
Do maintain single-line state summaries (white-space: nowrap) in .right-court-outliner across 1586px, 1440px, and 1280px desktop breakpoints.
donts: Don't introduce ornate EU4-style gilded frames, heraldic crests, hanging pennants, decorative province paintings, or dark slate/charcoal panels.
Don't display server truth values on the map, top bar, or state sheet unless Debug Truth mode is explicitly authenticated and active.
Don't allow map labels, sub-captions, or lower-right map controls to bleed through or clip behind the open state sheet on <=960px mobile viewports.
Don't use CSS transform scaling on the map container; perform all zoom and pan updates through the SVG viewBox and labelScale so strokes and typography stay crisp.
Don't invent custom metaphors, fictional dynasty names, or non-standard accounting terms in UI copy; use the standard ledger labels (账面, 可支配, 未知).
